statement: You are given a positive integer n.
Return every positive integer that divides n with no remainder, in increasing order.
Divisors come in pairs i and n / i, so it is enough to test values of i up to √n.

examples.explanation: Testing i = 1 to 6 finds the pairs (1, 36), (2, 18), (3, 12), (4, 9) and (6, 6). The 6 is listed once.
17 is prime, so its only divisors are 1 and itself.
